---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new pattern, control, or export format
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## What you want

A clear, one-paragraph description of the feature and the user problem it
solves.

## Why now

Link any related issues, prior art, or screenshots. If this is a port of a
classic effect (Perlin, voronoi, GLSL textbook, etc.), name the source.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Behavior A
- [ ] Behavior B
- [ ] Updated test in `src/__tests__/lib/patternRegistry.test.ts` if a new
      `TextureType` is added.
- [ ] Documented in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` if it changes the shader pipeline.

## Out of scope

Anything that should explicitly not be part of this change.
